---
title: "Dashboard Homework 4"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
data("rest_inspec")

rest_inspec =
  rest_inspec |>
  select(
    camis, inspection_date, inspection_type,
    boro, latitude, longitude, score, grade, zipcode, critical_flag, 
    dba, cuisine_description
  )
```

Column {data-width=500}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Restaurant Location Colored by Most Recent A-C Grade in Manhattan

```{r}
rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"),
    !is.na(latitude),
    !is.na(longitude),
    latitude != 0,
    longitude != 0,
    boro == "Manhattan"
    ) |>
  group_by(camis) |>
  slice_max(inspection_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Restaurant: ", dba, "\nGrade: ", grade)) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~longitude, y = ~latitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~grade, text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5)
```

Column {data-width=400}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Inspection Score by Cuisine Type {data-height=525}

```{r}
rest_inspec |> 
  filter(cuisine_description %in% c("Mexican", "Greek", "Japanese", "Indian", "Spanish", "Thai", "Bakery", "Chinese", "Italian", "Mediterranean"),!is.na(score)) |>
  distinct(camis, inspection_date, inspection_type, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(cuisine_description = fct_reorder(cuisine_description, score)) |> 
  plot_ly(y = ~score, color = ~cuisine_description, type = "box", colors = "viridis") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Cuisine Type"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Inspection Score")
  )
```

### Top 15 Manhattan Zipcodes by Critical Violation Count {data-height=475}

```{r}
rest_inspec |>
  filter(boro == "Manhattan", critical_flag == "Y", !is.na(zipcode)) |>
  count(zipcode) |>
  slice_max(n, n = 15) |>
  mutate(zipcode = fct_reorder(as.factor(zipcode), n)) |>
  plot_ly(x = ~zipcode, y = ~n, type = "bar") |>
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "ZIP Code"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Critical Violations")
  )
```
